findings.highlight: I run, suppressing my raging heart
findings.evidenceJa: 荒れ狂う心音、狂いそうな動悸を抑えて走り出す
findings.governingReading: He starts running while suppressing the violent heartbeat and palpitations that feel capable of driving him mad.
findings.explanation: The doubled cardiac panic and threat of madness collapse into a generic raging heart.

findings.highlight: This church is a terrible place for Emiya Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎にとってこの教会は鬼門だ
findings.governingReading: For Emiya Shirou, this church is an ill-fated gate / taboo quarter.
findings.explanation: A marked omen-and-direction term becomes a flat quality judgment.

findings.highlight: The unease in my back remains
findings.evidenceJa: 背中に張り付いた不安は、まだ剥がれない
findings.governingReading: The unease clinging to my back still will not peel away.
findings.explanation: The physical pursuit image is reduced to an odd location phrase.

findings.highlight: I’m surprised
findings.evidenceJa: 目が点になった
findings.governingReading: My eyes went round / became dots.
findings.explanation: A comic visual reaction is replaced by its generic implication.

findings.highlight: I was really relieved, knowing that I could come back to you
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーのところに帰ってきて良かったって、心底ホッとした
findings.governingReading: I was relieved from the bottom of my heart that I had come back to you, Saber.
findings.explanation: Relief at the accomplished return to Saber becomes relief at possessing the ability to return.

findings.highlight: I think that choice was a good one
findings.evidenceJa: あの時の選択は正しかったのだと信じられた
findings.governingReading: He could believe that the choice then was right.
findings.explanation: A hard-won belief in correctness is softened into a casual favorable opinion.

findings.highlight: If some collateral were provided
findings.evidenceJa: 見返りがあるのなら
findings.governingReading: If there is something in return for him.
findings.explanation: Payment or reciprocal benefit is mistranslated as security pledged against an obligation.

findings.highlight: we should be able to come up with some measures
findings.evidenceJa: 活路の一つや二つは見出せるだろう
findings.governingReading: They should be able to find one or two paths to survival.
findings.explanation: The battle image and stakes become generic countermeasures.

findings.highlight: How to find Lancer
findings.evidenceJa: いかにランサーと接触するか
findings.governingReading: How to make contact with Lancer.
findings.explanation: The problem of safely establishing contact is narrowed to location.

findings.highlight: when there are only two of us left
findings.evidenceJa: 残り二人となったこの状況で
findings.governingReading: in this situation with only two remaining
findings.explanation: An elliptical war-count referent is reassigned to the current speakers.

findings.highlight: Lancer is a worthy hero
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーは気持ちのいい英霊です
findings.governingReading: Lancer is a refreshingly straightforward Heroic Spirit.
findings.explanation: Saber’s personal appraisal of his temperament becomes a judgment of martial worth.

findings.highlight: I’ll say you’re right
findings.evidenceJa: そういうコトにしといてあげる
findings.governingReading: I will let you leave it at that / pretend that is so.
findings.explanation: Rin’s teasing indulgence of Saber’s denial becomes agreement.

findings.highlight: she should wake up and wander in when she gets hungry
findings.evidenceJa: お腹が減ったら起きてくるだろう
findings.governingReading: She will probably get up when she becomes hungry.
findings.explanation: The English invents wandering into the room.

findings.highlight: don’t do anything until then
findings.evidenceJa: それまで大人しくしてるのよ
findings.governingReading: Behave yourselves / stay quietly out of trouble until then.
findings.explanation: Rin’s admonition becomes a blanket ban on action.

findings.highlight: N-No… umyes, some more tea, please
findings.evidenceJa: い、いえ、そのそう、お茶のお代わりをお願いします
findings.governingReading: N-No, um—yes. More tea, please.
findings.explanation: The stammered pivot is fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: If something happens, I’ll let you deal with it
findings.evidenceJa: 何かあったら、対処を頼む
findings.governingReading: If anything happens, I am counting on you to handle it.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s request and reliance on Saber becomes permissive delegation.

findings.highlight: I abandoned my rights as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターを放棄し
findings.governingReading: having renounced being a Master
findings.explanation: A relinquished role/status is recast as a bundle of rights.

findings.highlight: It must be like yesterday for you
findings.evidenceJa: おまえにとっては先日の話だろうが
findings.governingReading: For you it may be an event of only the other day.
findings.explanation: Concrete relative recency becomes a loose simile.

findings.highlight: perhaps I am not that bad
findings.evidenceJa: 私も捨てたものではない
findings.governingReading: I too may be more formidable than one might dismiss.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s self-satisfied idiom is weakened into mild moral self-evaluation.

findings.highlight: The air tenses
findings.evidenceJa: ギリギリと絞り込まれていく空気
findings.governingReading: The air is squeezed tighter and tighter.
findings.explanation: The escalating constriction and sound texture disappear.

findings.highlight: getting such rude pressure from the Servant of the man who shot me
findings.evidenceJa: かつてこの胸を撃ち抜いた男のサーヴァントに、ここまで不躾な殺気を向けられては
findings.governingReading: to have such insolent killing intent directed at me by the Servant of the man who once shot through this chest
findings.explanation: Both the bodily wound and Saber’s killing intent are generalized.

findings.highlight: I won’t die that easily even if something happens
findings.evidenceJa: もし何かあってもすぐにはやられない
findings.governingReading: Even if something happens, I will not be taken down immediately.
findings.explanation: A claim about buying response time becomes a stronger claim about survivability.

findings.highlight: an excessive worrier
findings.evidenceJa: 過保護すぎるようだな
findings.governingReading: seems excessively protective of you
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s taunt about Saber’s protective conduct becomes an inward emotional trait.

findings.highlight: I can see the mansion clearly
findings.evidenceJa: 屋敷の造りも把握できる
findings.governingReading: I can grasp the layout of the mansion.
findings.explanation: Tactical knowledge of the house’s structure becomes mere visibility.

findings.highlight: A big smile, full of compassion
findings.evidenceJa: 深い、慈悲に満ちたような笑み
findings.governingReading: A deep smile that seems filled with compassion.
findings.explanation: The ominous depth and qualified appearance of compassion are flattened.

findings.highlight: He throws something onto the grass
findings.evidenceJa: 何か、得体の知れないモノを投げた
findings.governingReading: He threw some unidentified, unfathomable thing onto the grass.
findings.explanation: The object’s deliberate unknowability at first sight disappears.

findings.highlight: The boundary field Father put up
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オヤジ char=2]切嗣の張った結界
findings.governingReading: the bounded field Kiritsugu—Dad—set up
findings.explanation: The written name and intimate reading are collapsed into only the reading.

findings.highlight: it looks like it can only be the corpse of a small child
findings.evidenceJa: 幼い抜け殻にしか見えないもの
findings.governingReading: something that can only look like a young, empty shell
findings.explanation: The English identifies a corpse before the source’s staged correction that the apparent shell is alive.

findings.highlight: Its limbs are cut off, there’s only the head and the body, the skin is peeled off, the meat is rotting, but the child is alive
findings.evidenceJa: 目を背けたくなるほど無残なその子供は生きている
findings.governingReading: The child, so horribly ruined that one wants to look away, is alive.
findings.explanation: The English inserts extensive dismemberment, flaying, and putrefaction absent from this source page.

findings.highlight: my heart has been pierced
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓を破壊され
findings.governingReading: my heart has been destroyed
findings.explanation: The result of the attack is weakened from destruction to piercing.

findings.highlight: I’m spewing out blood from my mouth like a hose. mouth.
findings.evidenceJa: 口から溢れるように血を吐いている
findings.governingReading: blood is pouring as I vomit it from my mouth
findings.explanation: An unsupported hose simile and stray repeated word replace the source’s overflow image.

findings.highlight: What fills my body is wonder
findings.evidenceJa: 体を支配していたのは疑問だけだった
findings.governingReading: Only the question ruled his body.
findings.explanation: Total domination by a question becomes the milder and semantically different feeling of wonder.

findings.highlight: a corpse that isn’t even human anymore
findings.evidenceJa: もう人間とは呼べない子供の亡骸
findings.governingReading: the remains/form of a child no longer recognizable as human
findings.explanation: After explicitly stating the child lives, the English reasserts that the child is a corpse and makes nonhuman status categorical.
